title: SLO initiative journey mapping and commitment templates
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a repeatable initiative lifecycle (journey) for SLO-driven reliability work that standardizes commitments, telemetry templates, gating criteria, and handoffs. Scope: build a set of editable commitment templates (charter + acceptance + rollback triggers), a telemetry checklist for common Redwood surfaces (API generation, Dedicated pools, Private/VPC), an onboarding checklist for initiative owners, and console gating knobs for progressive rollouts. Out of scope: automatic enforcement of billing quotas and automated remediation; those will be follow-ups. Deliverables: 1) SLO Initiative Journey map artifact, 2) Commitment template pack (charter, acceptance criteria, error budget banding, rollback recipe), 3) Telemetry & alerting checklist with example panels and SLI queries, 4) Console gating proposal and API contract for gating metadata, 5) Playbook entry for oncall handoffs and verification steps.
acceptance_criteria: A documented journey map graphic that traces Initiation -> SLI definition -> Baseline -> Error-budget allocation -> Rollout plan -> Canary gating -> Full rollout -> Monitoring & runway reviews
A set of three commitment templates (low/medium/high customer impact) in Google Docs with editable fields for owner, SLIs, measurement windows, and rollback triggers
Telemetry checklist with example PromQL/SQL queries for token-level latency P50/P95, KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution, and per-route error rate
Console gating proposal with metadata contract (how to attach SLO and error-budget policy to a rollout) and at least one mocked UI flow
Onboarding checklist and a one-page playbook for running the first 90 days of an SLO initiative reviewed by SRE and Eng leads
No critical feedback blocking signoff from Reliability and Product by the due_date

decisions: Keep initial scope to templates and proposal only — defer enforcement automation to a follow-up initiative
Adopt three commitment tiers to simplify executive sign-off: low (informational), medium (requires PM + Eng), high (requires Eng + SRE + Security review)
Use Prometheus/ClickHouse hybrid examples in templates to match current telemetry stack
Expose minimal 'slo_meta' in rollout API (labels + error_budget_policy_ref) rather than a full policy DSL to reduce coupling
